journey: Before the final copy/contrast/search-focus repairs, desktop and phone each opened an exact result, inspected changes, submitted realistic feedback and created an explicit revision. Expanded plans retained exact feedback and source run; nothing was approved or dispatched. Unchanged delivery/approval/feedback behavior is covered again by the final focused client/server tests.
recovery: In the same isolated session, an unsent phone draft survived reload. Expiring the fixture login in a second tab disabled send, showed Reconnect, and restored the same draft after sign-in without submitting it. Lost network-response handling is covered by the single-POST receipt regression.
limitations: Physical phone software keyboard and screen-reader behavior not verified.
Project and knowledge screens reuse existing native forms within the new shell; richer source previews and recent-chat history are subsequent component migrations.
